Part A: Basic Operations


A1 Create v as the sequence 5, 10, 15, ...., 50 using seq(). Print its length, sum and mean.

```{r}
v <- seq(5:50)
length(v)
sum(v)
mean(v)
```
A2 Create w that repeats the vector c(1, 2, 3) four times, and z that rpeats each element of c(1, 2, 3) four times. Print both.

```{r}
w <- rep(1:3, by = 4) 
z <- rep(1:3, 4)

```


A3 Compute and print: the remainder of 17 divided by 5, the integer division of 17 by 5, 2 to the power of 10, square the root of 144, and pi rounded to 3 decimals.
```{r}
 17 %/% 5
 17 %% 5
 2^10
 sqrt (144) 
 

```

A4 Given a <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)  and b <- c(1, 3, 5, 7), print a + b, a * b, the logical comparison a > b, and the dot product sum (a * b).

```{r}
a <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)
b <- c(1, 3, 5, 7)

a + b
a * b
a > b
sum(a*b)
```

A5 Use paste() to produce "Student-1" "Student-2" "Student-3". Then identify the datatype of 42, 42L, "42", 41i, and TRUE. What are its output?

```{r}

paste("Student-1", "Student-2", "Student-3")
class(42)
class(42L)
class("42")
class(41i)
class(TRUE)
```
